entries.name: Add State(s) to Queue__jki_lib_state_machine
entries.vi_path: addons/_JKI Toolkits/State Machine/_JKI_lib_State_Machine.llb/Add State(s) to Queue__jki_lib_state_machine.vi
entries.description: JKI State Machine: joins State(s) in Front, State(s) in and State(s) at Back into States Out, each trimmed of leading and trailing tabs, line feeds, carriage returns and spaces, with a line feed between the parts that are not empty.

entries.name: Parse State Queue__jki_lib_state_machine
entries.description: JKI State Machine: takes the first state off State Queue. Blank lines and text after //, # or /* on a line are skipped, and the state is split at >> into Current State and Arguments. An error in gives the state Error Handler.
entries.python_code:
{remaining_states} = {state_queue}
{current_state} = ''
{arguments} = ''
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    {current_state} = 'Error Handler'
elif {state_queue} != '':
    _queue = {state_queue}
    while True:
        _end = re.search('[\r\n]+', _queue)
        _line = _queue if _end is None else _queue[:_end.start()]
        _rest = '' if _end is None else _queue[_end.end():]
        _comment = min([len(_line)] + [_at for _at in (_line.find('//'), _line.find('#'), _line.find('/*')) if _at >= 0])
        _text = _line[:_comment].lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t')
        _queue = _rest.lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t\r\n')
        _split = re.search('[ \t]*>>[ \t]*', _text)
        _state = _text if _split is None else _text[:_split.start()]
        _arguments = '' if _split is None else _text[_split.end():]
        if _queue == '' or _state != '':
            break
    {remaining_states} = _queue
    {current_state} = _state
    {arguments} = _arguments

entries.name: Start CLI Interface
entries.vi_path: Wiresmith Technology/G CLI/CLI Class/Start CLI Interface.vi
entries.description: G CLI: gives the program's own command-line arguments (those after -- when it is started by G CLI) as Custom Parameters and the directory it was started from as Working Directory. With an error in, Custom Parameters is empty and Working Directory is /C. CLI out is None: a Python program has no connection to a command-line launcher.
entries.python_code:
{cli_out} = None
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    {custom_parameters} = []
    {working_directory} = Path('C:/')
else:
    {custom_parameters} = sys.argv[1:]
    {working_directory} = Path.cwd()

entries.name: Exit With Error Cluster Code
entries.vi_path: Wiresmith Technology/G CLI/CLI Class/Exit With Error Cluster Code.vi
entries.description: G CLI: ends the program with an exit code. With an error in whose status is True, it writes the error to standard error between lines of = signs and exits with the error's code; otherwise (no error, or a warning) it exits with No Error Code.
entries.python_code:
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    sys.stderr.write('==============
Error At Exit:
' + str({error_in}) + '
==============
')
    sys.exit({error_in}.code)
sys.exit({no_error_code})
